content.title: Review idea: apply waitForResponse fix to sibling parent-selector test
content.description: Review the idea filed by webapp-validator (issue mqgw46luxr): apply the waitForResponse-before-fill flake fix already applied to 'changes an existing parent' to its sibling test 'sets a parent via search and selection' (phase3-validation.spec.ts ~line 1235), scoping the matcher to the exact search term, and audit other search-response waits in the file for the same anti-pattern. Decide: ACCEPT (plan implementation), NEEDS REFINEMENT, or DISCARD. Add your decision as a comment.

content.content:
Review decision: ACCEPT (apply the fix).

Verified against the actual code in packages/webapp e2e phase3-validation.spec.ts. The sibling test "sets a parent via search and selection" lines ~1235 to 1285 has the exact same anti-pattern that was fixed in "changes an existing parent".

The problematic block:
  await searchInput.fill("Set Parent Target");
  await page.waitForResponse(matcher, timeout);

Both defects are present.
  1. Attach-order race. waitForResponse is registered AFTER the fill that triggers the search request, so a fast search response can fire before the listener attaches and the wait hangs or latches onto a stale response.
  2. Loose matcher. It only checks that the url includes the issues api path and the text search=, with no method pin and no scoping to the exact search term, so it can match an unrelated GET.

Fix plan, same recipe already applied to the sibling:
  - Move the waitForResponse promise ABOVE the fill call.
  - Scope the matcher to method GET, url on the issues endpoint, and new URL of resp.url with searchParams.get of search equal to the literal string Set Parent Target.

Audit of the rest of the file:
  I inspected every waitForResponse call. No other instance of the search-response attach-order anti-pattern. The tree-expand wait at line 1029 correctly registers the promise before the triggering click, and all other waits pair with click actions and set the promise up first. No other loose search matchers exist.

Scope is limited to this one test. Low risk, mechanical change. Ready for implementation.

Status-loop audit: review is complete (ACCEPT decision documented above), but status was left in-progress. Marking done per the 'agent forgot done' recipe. This auto-clears the blockage on gate tracker mqgwn6zwiu so the PM can read the decision and unblock implementation.
